description.zh: 分页大小。取值范围：10-100。默认为50。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50.

description.zh: 参数名称。**本Action下的Name为模糊匹配。**
description.en: The name of the parameter. **You can enter a keyword to query parameter names in fuzzy match mode.
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

description.zh: 参数路径。例如：Name为/path/path1/Myparameter 此时包含参数路径。
description.en: The path of the parameter. For example, if the name of a parameter is /path/path1/Myparameter, the path of the parameter is /path/path1/.

description.zh:
参数路径是否递归。
默认：false
description.en: Specifies whether to query parameters from all levels of directories in the specified path. Default value: false.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh:
根据字段排序。取值范围：

- Name（参数名称）

- CreatedDate（创建时间）
description.en:
The field used to sort the query results. Valid values:

*   Name
*   CreatedDate

description.zh:
排序顺序。取值范围：

- Ascending（升序）

- Descending（默认值）：降序
description.en:
The order in which the entries are sorted. Valid values:

*   Ascending
*   Descending (Default)

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前有操作KMS secret对应权限。
descriptions.en: Before you call this operation, make sure that you have the permission to manage Key Management Service (KMS) secrets.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos list-secret-parameters --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MySecretParameter --max-results 50 --next-token sPH90GZOVGC6KPDUL0FIIbEtMQHq_19S6_4O_XqA --sort-field Name --sort-order Descending --path /path1/path2/ --recursive false --tags k1=v1 k2=v2 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxsn4m4000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos ListSecretParameters --region cn-hangzhou --Path '/path1/path2/' --NextToken sPH90GZOVGC6KPDUL0FIIbEtMQHq_19S6_4O_XqA --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxsn4m4000000' --MaxResults 50 --SortOrder Descending --SortField Name --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Recursive false --Tags '{"k1":"v1","k2":"v2"}' --Name MySecretParameter
